Registrar October31notice expressly states the report shows every contest/candidate appearing on November3county ballots. All82local blocks were natively parsed and visually checked. Zero-report totals are placeholders, never actual election results. Actual current sample files acquired:0; all81installable fields retain explicit sample-acquisition gaps.

One additional HuronCityCouncil short-term field contains only a generic Write-in row, no named candidate. It is held separately, with no ordinary placeholder person. Named local certified-write-in inventory and cancellation/offballot lists remain unacquired; the www2qualified/offballot links return HTML RequestRejected under HTTP200. No field is invented from Juneprimary candidate data.

Six original FifthDistrict retention office/person IDs and core fields are preserved. All current California lane inputs were checked for shared exact school/special/regional identities;75ordinary fields and195candidacies are new. The exact nine whole counties listed by the official FifthDistrict court are supplied as districtMemberships. No whole county/city/school is substituted for a subdistrict.

Canonical school identities are disambiguated with current government records: PacificUnionElementaryFresno NCES0629400; WashingtonUnifiedFresno NCES0601415. Each numbered trustee/council/supervisor/director/division/zone electorate retains its exact source scope, with missing reader geometry explicit. MercedCountyBoardEducationDistrict5 and StateCenterCollege trusteearea1 remain exact cross-county offices, not countywide Fresno races.

Registrar October31notice confirms FresnoUnified trusteeareas1/3/4 are FresnoUnified despite Fowler mislabels on some ballot-marking-device prints. Current inventory and exact FresnoUnified electorates are used. Existing statewide, legislative and measure records/explanations remain unchanged.

Official county VoterGuide redirects to an OmniBallot workflow configured for first name,last name,dateofbirth; no voter identity was submitted. Public election metadata found no current/upcoming entry and past entries only through2025. Public government mirror searches did not yield a current2026sample. These are source-access findings, not proof the government publishes no samples.
